gloss: rival warlords; rival heroes; competing powers

definitions.gloss: rival warlords; rival heroes; competing powers
definitions.explanation: Multiple powerful leaders or factions competing for dominance. Originally used for warring feudal lords, now also applied figuratively to businesses, athletes, or other competitors vying for the top position.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦国時代|せんごくじだい}→戦国時代：19200_sengokujidai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{群雄|ぐんゆう}{割拠|かっきょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧だった。
examples.english: The Sengoku period was an era of rival warlords vying for power.

examples.japanese: IT⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{群雄|ぐんゆう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{競|きそ}い{合|あ}う→競い合う：04656_kisoiau⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧だ。
examples.english: The IT industry is a world where rival powers compete with one another.

examples.japanese: {群雄|ぐんゆう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{覇者|はしゃ}→覇者：24558_hasha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現|あらわ}れた→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧。
examples.english: From among the rival powers, one champion emerged.

notes:
USAGE:
{群雄|ぐんゆう} literally means "a group of heroes" and most commonly appears in the compound ⟦{群雄割拠|ぐんゆうかっきょ}→群雄割拠：15952_gunyuukakkyo⟧ (rival warlords each holding their own territory). While historically about feudal warfare, it is now widely used as a metaphor for intense competition in business, sports, and other fields.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{群雄割拠|ぐんゆうかっきょ}→群雄割拠：15952_gunyuukakkyo⟧ (rival powers each occupying their own territory — set expression)
- {群雄|ぐんゆう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{競|きそ}い{合|あ}う→競い合う：04656_kisoiau⟧ (rival powers compete with each other)
- {群雄|ぐんゆう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧ (one of the competing powers)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{覇者|はしゃ}→覇者：24558_hasha⟧ refers to the eventual winner or champion who emerges from the competition. {群雄|ぐんゆう} refers to the multiple competitors collectively, before a single winner is determined.
